name: Trust No Man
overview: Scripture clearly warns against placing trust in man, emphasizing instead the necessity of relying wholly on the LORD. The psalmist declares it is better to trust in God than in princes or men (Psalms 118:8-9), while Jeremiah pronounces a curse on those who make flesh their strength and turn their hearts away from the LORD (Jeremiah 17:5). Isaiah condemns those who seek help from worldly powers rather than looking to the Holy One of Israel (Isaiah 31:1). True trust is characterized by wholehearted dependence on God rather than human understanding or strength (Proverbs 3:5).
